page.notes: The handwritten "186" at top right is not printed and is left out. The word after "tametsi" is printed "metsiarctioribus" and is read here as "tametsi arctioribus"; the first letters are doubtful. The French quotation lines are each introduced by a printed opening quotation mark. Some French spellings ("etablissent", "pretendent") are copied as printed, with the accents missing from the scan.
